# guardium-data-protection_edge_deploy (Resource)

Deploys GDP Edge components to a Kubernetes cluster using native Kubernetes API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `cleanup_bundle` (Boolean) Whether to cleanup downloaded bundle on destroy (default: true)
- `delete_timeout` (String) Timeout for the delete operation (e.g. '2h', '90m'). Default: 2h.
- `edge_bundle_directory` (String) Local path to pre-extracted edge bundle directory
- `edge_name` (String) Name of the edge to download from Central Manager (requires cm_url and oauth_token in provider config)
- `eks_cluster_name` (String) AWS EKS cluster name
- `external_image_registry` (Boolean) Set to true when using an external image registry (e.g. Docker Hub, Quay) instead of the CM private registry. Skips registry certificate installation on cluster nodes (default: false).
- `k3s_master_node` (String) K3S master node hostname/IP for kubeconfig fetch
- `k3s_nodes` (List of String) List of K3S node hostnames/IPs for certificate installation
- `k8s_metrics_server_airgap_install` (Boolean) Use airgap (offline) installation for Kubernetes Metrics Server. Reads YAML manifests from k8s_metrics_server_airgap_install_path (default: false).
- `k8s_metrics_server_airgap_install_path` (String) Local directory path containing Metrics Server YAML manifests for airgap installation. Required when k8s_metrics_server_airgap_install is true.
- `k8s_metrics_server_install` (Boolean) Whether to install Kubernetes Metrics Server before deploying Edge. Uses AWS SDK credentials — no static Kubernetes token required (default: false).
- `monitor_max_attempts` (Number) Maximum polling attempts for deployment monitoring (default: 180)
- `monitor_sleep_interval` (Number) Sleep interval in seconds between monitoring polls (default: 10)
- `ocp_insecure_skip_verify` (Boolean) Skip TLS verification for OpenShift API server (overrides provider setting)
- `ocp_machineconfig_timeout` (String) Timeout for OpenShift MachineConfig rollout during certificate installation (e.g. '10m', '30m', '1h'). Default: 60m. Increase this for large clusters or slow node updates.
- `ocp_password` (String, Sensitive) OpenShift password (overrides provider setting)
- `ocp_server` (String) OpenShift API server URL (overrides provider setting)
- `ocp_token` (String, Sensitive) OpenShift OAuth token (overrides provider setting)
- `ocp_username` (String) OpenShift username (overrides provider setting)
- `platform` (String) Target platform: k3s, eks, or openshift (overrides provider setting)

### Read-Only

- `deployment_status` (String) Final deployment status
- `edge_namespace` (String) Kubernetes namespace where Edge components are deployed
- `id` (String) Unique identifier for this edge deployment
- `last_updated` (String) Timestamp of last update
- `registry_url` (String) Container registry URL extracted from bundle
- `work_dir` (String) Working directory for the edge bundle
